bfs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Performs a staged BFS over a 10x10 grid by marking cells around each special point and expanding the current frontier through those cells, returning true if all special points are processed while the frontier is still nonempty." bfs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> sx </REF>: int "Initial x-coordinate of the BFS starting position."
        <REF> sy </REF>: int "Initial y-coordinate of the BFS starting position."
        <REF> spx </REF>: int[] "Array of x-coordinates of the special points to process in order."
        <REF> spy </REF>: int[] "Array of y-coordinates of the special points to process in order."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "Returns true if all special points have been processed while the current queue is still nonempty; otherwise returns false after the queue becomes empty."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize size = 10, spCnt = 0, dx/dy as the 12 move offsets, dx2/dy2 as the 9-cell marking offsets, park as a new boolean[size][size] grid, and queueX/queueY as empty LinkedLists. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND Add sx to queueX and sy to queueY. RESULT queueX, queueY]
            [COMMAND While queueX is not empty, execute the following steps as an outer-while iteration. RESULT current_queue_state]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, test the early-success condition spCnt == spx.length; if it is true, take the alternative early-return-true path. RESULT condition_result]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, using the current special point (spx[spCnt], spy[spCnt]), for i from 0 through dx2.length - 1, compute y = spy[spCnt] + dy2[i] and x = spx[spCnt] + dx2[i]; if 0 <= y < size and 0 <= x < size, set park[y][x] = true. RESULT park]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, create empty queues nx and ny for the next frontier. RESULT nx, ny]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, while queueX is not empty, dequeue x = queueX.poll() and y = queueY.poll(); for i from 0 through dx.length - 1, compute nextX = x + dx[i] and nextY = y + dy[i]; if 0 <= nextX < 10 and 0 <= nextY < 10 and park[nextY][nextX] is true, add nextX to nx and nextY to ny. RESULT nx, ny]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, after draining the current queues, increment spCnt by 1. RESULT spCnt]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, reset park = new boolean[size][size], clearing all previously marked cells. RESULT park]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer while loop, assign queueX = nx and queueY = ny for the next outer iteration. RESULT queueX, queueY]
            [COMMAND If the outer while loop exits because queueX became empty before spCnt reached spx.length, return false. RESULT false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: At the start of an outer-while iteration, spCnt == spx.length, meaning all special points have been processed while the current frontier queue is still nonempty.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return true immediately. RESULT true]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
